executive_summary: Stockholm closes the quarter the way it opened it: GOP essentially on target against Budget (+1.9%), and every flagged item favorable. Property Operations & Maintenance and IT & Systems have now run consistently under Budget for three straight months — at this point it's simply how the department operates, not a one-off worth continued flagging.
profitability_summary: GOP was 757,708 SEK against a Budget of 743,602 SEK, up 1.9% (14,106 SEK) — on target, capping a quarter where GOP beat or matched Budget every single month.

category_narratives.property_ops_maint: Property Operations & Maintenance ran 8.0% under Budget for the third consecutive month — a sustained, consistent pattern rather than noise. Worth a check-in with the team on whether this reflects genuinely lower maintenance need or deferred work; three months running is long enough that it's worth confirming deliberately rather than assuming.
category_narratives.it_systems: IT & Systems ran 8.0% under Budget, the third straight month at the same margin — consistent, sustained cost control.
category_narratives.ebitda: EBITDA beat Budget by 2.5%, carried by the same Property Operations & Maintenance and IT & Systems savings as GOP.
category_narratives.ebit: EBIT beat Budget by 3.1% — the same underlying driver, flowing through cleanly.
category_narratives.pretax_income: Pre-tax Income beat Budget by 3.4% — a clean, favorable quarter end to end, with no offsetting concerns below GOP.
